spells.fillerNotes: No unified 'core loadout' spell list stated outside the two named builds — OP ties skills to playstyle instead (see builds[] for per-build skill picks: Pushback/Weapon Dance/The Old Billhook for CC; Pushback/The Old Billhook/Halberdiers Thrust or Bec de Corbin for Glass Cannon).

builds.name: Tanky + Full Unit CC
builds.summary: Focuses on crowd control, locking down enemy heroes and units for extended periods. Key skills: Pushback, Weapon Dance, The Old Billhook. Pushback instantly removes you from CC while stunning enemies hit — a crucial survival and disruption tool. Weapon Dance debuffs enemy units by reducing their damage and movement speed, while boosting your defensive stats for 6 seconds based on how many enemies hit. Ultimate: either works — one offers full hero CC to pin down enemies, the other delivers burst damage with minor CC spread across 5 waves. OP recommends the 5-wave CC ultimate as it "will help you win a lot of units trade."

builds.name: Full Damage (Glass Cannon)
builds.summary: Emphasizes maximizing damage at the cost of defense. Uses Pushback, The Old Billhook, and either Halberdiers Thrust (for heroes) or Bec de Corbin (for units). Halberdiers Thrust excels at dealing damage to enemy heroes. Bec de Corbin is designed to cleave through enemy units. Ultimate: Lochabar Strike recommended for burst damage, though both ultimates are viable depending on the situation.
